description: This file defines a MetricsPipeline class that performs background polling, aggregation, and storage of network metrics from a Xena client, including handling gaps and non-monotonic timestamps.

classes.name: _LastState
classes.description: Data class to store the last snapshot and sequence number for delta calculations.

classes.name: MetricsPipeline
classes.description: Main class responsible for polling, aggregating, compensating, and persisting network metrics.

methods.name: _run_loop
methods.description: Main loop that periodically polls metrics and handles errors and timing.

methods.name: _poll_once
methods.description: Performs a single poll of metrics, handles gap detection, compensation, and updates repositories and observability metrics.
